feedback: Pre-race review. Nothing has raced for this candidate, so this states no outcome for it. The candidate is valid: five sensors match five weights, x-positions are within ±0.08 m, and kd 0.2 is inside its 0 to 10 range. It changes one group from the best raced design (iteration 4, score 40.6926): controller.kd from 0.1 to 0.2, with geometry, kp 2.5, ki 0.5, base_speed 1.4 and line_loss last_direction unchanged. Iteration 3 showed kp 3.0 to 2.5 barely moved the oval steering_oscillation (0.112 to 0.113), and iteration 4 showed ki 0.3 to 0.5 had no measurable effect (40.6925 to 40.6926). Every run on every track still ends off_track with max_error at 0.0609 to 0.0629 m, and line_loss_events is 0. That leaves the oval oscillation (0.113) as the one clearly unexplained symptom, so testing kd is the next step the evidence supports. The gain is small and the cost of this race is one action run, so approve it and let the telemetry decide. Watch one risk: with 1.5 outer weights, the derivative acts on fast signal changes, so kd 0.2 may amplify sensor noise. Check noise_robustness and steering_oscillation together on the next race. After the race, use the telemetry as follows. (a) If oval steering_oscillation falls below about 0.09 and max_error on the s-bend and slalom stays near 0.06 or improves, the oscillation is fixed but the error is a steady bias. Next, lower base_speed to about 1.2 to reduce slip and outward drift at speed, keeping gains fixed. (b) If kd 0.2 raises s-bend or slalom oscillation above about 0.08, or lowers progress, return kd to 0.1. (c) If max_error is still at or above 0.0629 and noise_robustness is low, the error may come from sensor noise rather than gain, so test a wider sensor set before more gain changes. Change one group of fields per revision.
requested_changes: After the race, if oval steering_oscillation falls below about 0.09 and max_error stays near 0.06 on the s-bend and slalom (steady bias, iteration 4 showed ki and kp did not move it), set controller.base_speed to about 1.2 with kp 2.5, ki 0.5 and kd 0.2 unchanged.

If the race shows s-bend or slalom steering_oscillation above about 0.08 (iteration 4 measured 0.0665 and 0.0633) or progress falling below iteration 4's 0.0406 and 0.035, set controller.kd back to 0.1 and keep kp 2.5 and ki 0.5.

If max_error stays at or above 0.0629 on every track with noise_robustness low, test a sixth sensor at x = 0.09 is out of range, so instead widen the outer sensors to x = ±0.07 (within the ±0.08 limit) with the outer weights kept at ±1.5, citing iteration 2's line-loss-free result at ±0.06.
